reviewNotes: The first twenty-five object strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placement restrictions, wallet powers, catalogue descriptions, recipe labels, placeholders, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

AncientFruitPot.source: Her roots grow very deep... she wouldn't be happy in there.
AncientFruitPot.translation: Rădăcinile ei cresc foarte adânc... nu s-ar simți bine acolo.

CactusSeedsOutside.source: Must be planted indoors or on Ginger Island.
CactusSeedsOutside.translation: Trebuie plantate în interior sau pe Insula Ghimbirului.

CatalogueDescription.source: Provides unlimited access to all wallpapers and floors... from the convenience of your home!
CatalogueDescription.translation: Oferă acces nelimitat la toate tapetele și pardoselile... chiar din confortul casei tale!

FurnitureCatalogueDescription.source: Provides unlimited access to almost every furniture item... from the convenience of your home!
FurnitureCatalogueDescription.translation: Oferă acces nelimitat la aproape toate piesele de mobilier... chiar din confortul casei tale!

DarkTalismanDescription.source: You've found the {0}! It's covered in bug slime...
DarkTalismanDescription.translation: Ai găsit {0}! Este acoperit de mâzgă de insecte...

MagicInkDescription.source: You've found the Wizard's lost {0}! Better return it to him.
MagicInkDescription.translation: Ai găsit {0} pierdută de Vrăjitor! Ar fi bine să i-o înapoiezi.

MagnifyingGlassDescription.source: You received the {0}! You now have the ability to find 'Secret Notes'. These notes reveal rare and useful information, and can be reviewed in your collections tab.
MagnifyingGlassDescription.translation: Ai primit {0}! Acum poți găsi „Notițe secrete”. Aceste notițe dezvăluie informații rare și utile și pot fi consultate în fila Colecții.

SpecialCharmDescription.source: You received the {0}! You feel an aura of good fortune surrounding you (luck is permanently increased)!
SpecialCharmDescription.translation: Ai primit {0}! Simți în jurul tău o aură de noroc (norocul este mărit permanent)!

ParsnipSeedPackage_SomeoneElse.source: This package belongs to someone else.

Acorn_Description.source: This can be planted to grow an oak tree.
Acorn_Description.translation: Poate fi plantată, iar din ea va crește un stejar.
